shackleton-rim.name: Shackleton Crater Rim
shackleton-rim.notes: Peak of near-eternal light bordering Shackleton PSR; extreme grazing solar angles.

mons-mouton.name: Mons Mouton
mons-mouton.notes: Flat-topped massif rising ~6 km above surrounding terrain; wide DTE communication window.

malapert-massif.name: Malapert Massif
malapert-massif.notes: Located on the 0 deg prime meridian; Earth remains persistently visible for DTE ops.

haworth-rim.name: Haworth Crater Rim
haworth-rim.notes: Steep surrounding crater rims produce sharp shadow transitions and narrow DTE margins.

nobile-rim-1.name: Nobile Rim 1
nobile-rim-1.notes: Favorable landing slopes (<10 deg) with balanced solar power and Earth visibility trade-offs.

apollo-11.name: Apollo 11 (Statio Tranquillitatis)
apollo-11.notes: Equatorial reference: ~14.8 Earth days of high-angle sunlight followed by ~14.8 days of night.
